definitions.gloss: banquet-style Japanese cuisine, formal multi-course dinner
definitions.explanation: A style of Japanese cuisine served as a sequence of courses at banquets, parties, or upscale restaurants. Emphasizes seasonal ingredients, beautiful presentation, and the social aspect of dining together.

examples.japanese: {会席|かいせき}⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予約|よやく}した→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧。
examples.english: I made a reservation for kaiseki cuisine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夕食|ゆうしょく}→夕食：03006_yuushoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{会席|かいせき}⟦コース→コース：10864_koosu⟧だった。
examples.english: Dinner at the inn was a kaiseki course meal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食材|しょくざい}→食材：04940_shokuzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ふんだん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧{会席|かいせき}⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{見|み}た{目|め}→見た目：14110_mitame⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: Kaiseki cuisine that uses seasonal ingredients abundantly is beautiful to look at as well.

notes:
Not to be confused with ⟦{懐石|かいせき}→懐石：12635_kaiseki⟧ (also read かいせき), which originally refers to the simple meal served before a tea ceremony. In modern usage, the two terms are often used interchangeably for formal Japanese course meals, but their origins differ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {会席|かいせき}⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧ (kaiseki cuisine, banquet-style meal)
- {会席|かいせき}⟦コース→コース：10864_koosu⟧ (kaiseki course meal)
- {会席|かいせき}{膳|ぜん} (kaiseki set meal/tray)

ETYMOLOGY:
{会席|かいせき} literally means "gathering seat" and originally referred to gatherings for ⟦{連歌|れんが}→連歌：16508_renga⟧ (linked verse poetry). The elaborate meals served at these gatherings evolved into the formal dining style known today.
